intro: Call of Air marks a major milestone in a Horde shaman's spiritual path, directing them to seek communion with the unpredictable element of wind. Offered by Xanis Flameweaver in Thunder Bluff, this quest bids seasoned initiates journey south into Thousand Needles to learn from Prate Cloudseer. Mastering air grants a shaman the sacred totem required to channel the swiftest forces of nature.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The winds of Kalimdor rush to meet you and you shall be counted among some of our most powerful friends. I am proud to see you have come this far and have such a promising future.
The element of air is a difficult one to control, but I have faith that your skills will overcome any obstacles that are placed in front of you.
Head to the very south of the Barrens, and enter Thousand Needles. It is there, far to the east, that you will find Prate Cloudseer. She will teach you more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: For the time being, I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
